Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. ****About The Role**** Join Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, as an Account Executive focusing on the Iberia (SMB) market. Based in our Dublin hub, you will lead the "agentic era" of technology, helping businesses transform through AI, Data, and CRM. Note: By applying to the Small Medium / Mid-market Business Account Executive posting, recruiters and hiring managers who support multiple cloud offerings and verticals across the organization hiring Small Medium Business Account Executives will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams. ****Key Requirements:**** * Language: Full professional fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. * Location: This is a Hybrid role based in Dublin, Ireland (Relocation assistance included). ****Overview Of The Role - Your Mission**** As an Account Executive for the Iberia ESMB team, you own the end-to-end sales cycle. You aren't just selling software; you are selling the Salesforce Customer 360 platform and Agentforce—the future of autonomous AI. You will balance "whitespace" prospecting (new business) with strategic expansion within existing accounts. ****Key Responsibilities**** * Full Cycle Sales: Lead a dedicated customer set in the Iberia market, managing complex sales projects from lead generation to closing. * Strategic Growth: Drive performance against key metrics with a primary focus on new business acquisition and expansion. * Solution Selling: Utilize a consultative approach to identify business challenges and align Salesforce AI and Data solutions to customer goals. * Relationship Building: Develop trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers through regular digital engagement and face-to-face meetings. * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business Development, Pre-sales, and Marketing to optimize the market funnel. ****Required Qualifications:**** **What We’re Looking For** * Demonstrated success of quota carrying, technology solution-based direct sales experience * Territory & Account Planning Strategies: Create territory and account plans to achieve sales objectives by effectively identifying and qualifying prospects and opportunities. * Research and Discovery: Uncovers a prospect’s current processes, business challenges, and strategic goals based on customer use cases and value hypotheses. * Solutioning: Identifies compelling value propositions that address customer needs by demonstrating an understanding of technology solutions. * Customer Communication: Interacting with customers in a clear, concise, and timely manner using a variety of communication methods (writing, speech, presentation) and tools (Whiteboarding, Slack, Google Slides, Zoom). * Resource Application: Continuously runs toward results using the full capabilities of available resources and tools. * Team Selling: Aligns with the full capacities of the account team and partners to support the deal and customer success. * Fluency in Portuguese and English ****Preferred Qualifications:**** * Sales Methodology education (like MEDDIC, Challenger, or Value Selling.) * Ability to develop cases and service requirements, while crafting and leading strategic alliances. * Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. * Track record of consistently achieving or surpassing quota. * Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role. ****What’s In It For You policies, plus comprehensive parental support programs. * Career Development: Access to world-class AI and sales training, mentorship, and a clear path for promotion within the global Salesforce ecosystem. * Giving Back: 7 paid volunteer days per year and donation matching for the causes you care about. * Perks: Employee discounts, inclusive resource groups, and a culture that celebrates Equality. Equality & Inclusion Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and ensure reasonable accommodations are provided throughout the recruitment process where required. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Account Executive, Mid Market (French Speaking)
description: **Why Harvey** At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** As a Mid Market Account Executive at Harvey, you will drive the growth and success of our AI solutions within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing and growing relationships with mid-sized law firms and corporate and financial services clients, understanding their unique challenges, and presenting AI solutions that streamline their processes and boost productivity. Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, coupled with your passion for groundbreaking AI technologies, will help us shape the future of knowledge work. **What You'll Do** * Own your book of business by managing a named account list, prioritizing and cultivating inbound leads, and outbounding directly to high-potential prospects. * Manage the full customer lifecycle from prospecting to contracting, onboarding, growing, and renewals. * Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics. * Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs. * Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the power of Harvey's AI systems to prospects and clients. * Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals. * Develop our sales playbook to enable scaling, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts. * Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices. **What You Have** * Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology. * Excited about prospecting, and capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. * Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene. * Ability to lead a complex, multi-threaded sale with stakeholders ranging from executives across various functions to day-to-day product users – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences. * Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently. * Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals. * Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success. * Experience working in or adjacent to the Legal industry a plus but not required. **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices [** **here** **].** *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

title: College Park Facilities Engineer

title: Data Platform Engineer - Cybersecurity
description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. Our mission is to build a next-generation, centralized data lakehouse that unifies all security telemetry into a single, high-performance ecosystem. Operating across two specialized verticals—Data Logistics (ingestion, enrichment, and semantic layers) and Data Platform (foundational infrastructure, security architecture, and AI enablement)—we are designing a scalable, cloud-native foundation from the ground up. By combining cutting-edge data architecture with advanced analytics, we empower our threat hunters, data scientists, and incident responders with the real-time, trusted intelligence needed to protect the enterprise at scale. The Data Platform Vertical As a member of the Data Platform vertical, you are joining the infrastructure backbone of this global organization. Operating across distributed hubs in Dublin, US, and New Zealand, we are the team responsible for ensuring the underlying architecture is highly performant, automated, and governed by strict enterprise standards. We are actively moving away from our SIEM-based data platform toward a modern, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) model. Crucially, our Dublin team serves as the anchor for our EU Sovereign operations, ensuring our modernized platform meets the strict data residency, isolation, and compliance mandates required to protect our European region. **About The Role** As a Cybersecurity Data Platform Engineer, you will bring hands-on data engineering expertise together with a strong Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mindset. While our Principal engineers architect the overarching system, your mission is to build, operate, and defend the reliability of our data pipelines and platform — scaling them efficiently and aggressively automating away manual toil. You will be the primary resource for break-fix, operational troubleshooting, and day-to-day care of our data pipelines and platform tooling, including Splunk during our transition away from a legacy, SIEM-centric environment that suffers from severe resource exhaustion. Prior Splunk experience is a bonus, not a requirement — we're glad to train the right person who brings strong data engineering, SRE/ops, cloud, and Linux fundamentals. Crucially, based in our Dublin hub, you will serve as the dedicated platform operator for our EU Sovereign Region. You will ensure that the daily operations, automation, and administration of the platform strictly adhere to European data residency, isolation, and compliance regulations. In this role, you will be on the front lines of data pipeline and platform health, defining reliability metrics, troubleshooting complex pipeline and infrastructure bottlenecks, and ensuring our Data Engineering and Incident Response teams always have a rock-solid foundation to execute their missions. What You Will Drive: * Data Pipeline & Platform Operations: Own the day-to-day administration, break-fix, and operational troubleshooting of our data pipelines and the broader cybersecurity data platform — including Splunk during our SIEM-to-IaC transition — to ensure maximum uptime, data flow integrity, and stability. * EU Sovereign Administration: Act as the dedicated, hands-on operator for our EU Sovereign Region, strictly adhering to established data residency and isolation protocols in all deployments and incident responses. * Defending Service Levels & Observability: Define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Objectives (SLOs) for platform health, compute usage, and storage capacity. You will actively monitor these metrics to proactively troubleshoot bottlenecks before they impact users. * Toil Reduction & IaC Execution: Treat operations as a software problem. You will utilize, maintain, and write Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation scripts to eliminate manual operational toil, streamline deployments, and enable auto-scaling. * Guardrails & Incident Response: Implement resource quotas and technical guardrails to protect the platform from noisy neighbors. When issues do occur, you will lead troubleshooting efforts and participate in blameless post-mortems to ensure systemic issues are fixed in code. **About You** You are an engineer who treats operations as a software problem. You have a deep preference for scripting and automating your way out of repetitive tasks. You understand that in a cybersecurity environment, platform downtime directly impacts enterprise defense, so you are dedicated to defending system stability and uptime. Most importantly, you understand that supporting a global security mission means following strict rules around access, governance, and compliance. **Basic Qualifications** * 4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, cloud infrastructure operations, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering (SRE) * 4+ years of experience administering enterprise Linux environments * 4+ years operating within major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), * 2+ years experience with compute, storage, networking, and Identity Access Management (IAM) * 2+ years of experience building, maintaining, or operating data pipelines (e.g., ETL/ELT, streaming, or batch processing) **Other Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Metrics and Observability: Practical experience building and managing monitoring, alerting, and logging platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to track SLIs/SLOs and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks proactively. You don't wait for users to report an outage — you catch issues before they surface. * Scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code: Hands-on experience writing and maintaining scripts (Python, Bash, Go) and working with IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation). You know how to safely modify and deploy automation to eliminate manual work and streamline routine operations. * Platform and Cloud Security Fundamentals: Understanding of platform, network, application, and cloud security fundamentals, tools, and concepts, with the ability to apply automation to ensure desired and consistent security configurations are maintained. * Compliance and Governance Awareness: Familiarity with data residency, isolation, and regulatory compliance requirements, particularly within a European or EU Sovereign context. You understand that supporting a global security mission means adhering to strict rules around access and governance. * Bonus: Hands-on experience with Splunk (administration, search, or troubleshooting) — not required, but valuable given our current environment; we're happy to train the right candidate. * Bonus: Experience with data reliability engineering — data quality monitoring, pipeline SLAs/SLOs, or data observability tooling. * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while handling operational responsibilities * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with partner teams across global time zones **Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)** Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here. title: Safeguarding Payment Analyst
description: **Overview** Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us achieve our mission. Microsoft Treasury supports the digital transformation journey of Microsoft’s customers, partners and vendors by providing competitive credit and payment solutions to support revenue growth while managing credit risk. We are a compliance-first organization with customer obsession and deal economics focus. We support over $150B in trade and receivables and $11B in payment solutions per year in global markets. The team is also charged with managing over $130B of investment portfolio, currency risk, bank account infrastructure and business risk insurance. As Safeguarding Payment Analyst, you will manage and execute the day-to-day management of daily safeguarding activities. You will also act as a key finance partner to the Head of Safeguarding, providing analysis, planning and broader financial management support while working closely with the Treasury Manager, Head of Safeguarding, Financial Manager and other key Treasury contacts. **Responsibilities** **Daily Safeguarding Calculations and Reconciliations** * Perform daily safeguarding calculations to identify client-fund liabilities using payment flows, settlement data and internal ledger records. * Reconcile calculated client-fund liabilities to internal ledgers, external bank statements and safeguarding account balances. * Verify that safeguarding account balances provide complete and adequate coverage of client funds in line with the approved methodology. * Complete daily activities within agreed cut-off times and retain clear evidence of preparation, review and completion. **Safeguarding Transfers and Account Monitoring** * Prepare and support timely safeguarding transfers to ensure full coverage of client-fund liabilities. * Monitor balances and movements across safeguarding accounts, identifying unusual transactions, shortfalls or excess balances. * Support the coordination of settlements, funding movements and permitted intercompany transfers in line with approved authorities and segregation-of-duties requirements. **Break Investigation and Escalation** * Investigate reconciliation breaks and data discrepancies promptly, documenting the cause, impact and corrective action. * Work with Finance, Treasury, IT, and banking partners to resolve outstanding items within agreed timelines. * Escalate safeguarding shortfalls, unexplained differences, missed deadlines and control failures promptly in accordance with governance procedures. * Track open breaks and remediation actions through to closure, providing clear status updates to relevant stakeholders. **Controls, Records and Reporting** * Operate safeguarding controls accurately, including required checks, approvals and segregation of duties. * Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready records of calculations, reconciliations, transfers, approvals, investigations and remediation actions. * Prepare routine safeguarding reports and management information for the Head of Safeguarding and other relevant stakeholders. * Support internal and external audits, regulatory submissions and Central Bank of Ireland information requests by providing accurate records and explanations. **Process Support and Continuous Improvement** * Follow documented safeguarding procedures and keep process notes, checklists and control evidence up to date. * Identify recurring breaks, manual inefficiencies and data-quality issues, and suggest practical improvements to processes and controls. * Support testing and implementation of system, data and process changes affecting safeguarding calculations or reconciliations. * Participate in cross-training, contingency arrangements and daily handovers to support continuity of safeguarding operations. **Qualifications** **Required qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business OR equivalent experience. * Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to deadlines. * Ability to build effective relationships with senior stakeholders, auditors and cross-functional partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business, OR Master's Degree in Business Administration or Finance, OR equivalent experience. * Experience in payments, e-money, financial services, technology, cloud services or online platforms. * Experience operating in a regulated entity or supporting safeguarding or operational-resilience requirements. * Experience with treasury management systems, analytics, automation, modelling or large-scale cash and reconciliation environments. Financial Analysis IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 60,300.00 - € 102,600.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. **Find Additional Benefits And Pay Information Here** https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/ireland-corporate-pay.html This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. title: Workplace & Technical Operations Generalist
description: **Main Mission** *The Workplace & Technical Operations Generalist, Dublin is a hands-on, field-oriented generalist whose core strength is event/AV production, backed by the ability to act as EMEA's remote hands for on-site technical troubleshooting and steady-state workplace operations for the Dublin office.* *This is a generalist role, not a specialist one. What matters most is genuine curiosity about technology, the ability to pick up new tools and workflows quickly, and comfort working independently and traveling autonomously across Dublin, Paris, and other EMEA office* **About The Role** * AV & Event Production (EMEA) * Provides hands on AV setup, teardown, and live support for all-hands, offsites, and internal events across Dublin, London, Paris, and other EMEA offices, in person or remotely. * Helps coordinate production vendors for larger events (staging, sound, lighting, streaming) region-wide. * Maintains and troubleshoots AV equipment and conferencing systems across meeting rooms EMEA-wide, picking up new AV/conferencing tools as needs evolve; no specific platform expertise is required going in. * Runs or supports livestreaming/broadcast setup for multi-office all-hands. * Builds local know-how so recurring AV/event needs don't require flying in outside support each time. * Remote Hands & On-Site Technical Support (EMEA) * Acts as EMEA's "remote hands": travels to Dublin, Paris, and other offices to physically diagnose and fix issues (e.g. a faulty device or cabling problem) so rooms and systems aren't down for weeks waiting on a specialist. * Provides on-site support for meeting rooms, network closets, and building-technology touchpoints across EMEA offices. * Coordinates with the PREWF infrastructure team on building systems (BMS, access control, smart lighting) rather than owning strategy or configuration decisions. * Escalates issues beyond hands-on physical troubleshooting rather than duplicating the helpdesk team's remit. * Workplace & Facilities Operations * Acts as a point of contact for day-to-day workplace matters in the Dublin office, including supplies, deliveries, and service providers. * Ensures meeting rooms, common areas, and shared spaces are maintained to a high standard. * Uses internal tools (e.g. Jira ticketing or similar) to track workplace and facilities requests. * Supports basic building maintenance coordination (HVAC, electrical, plumbing) with landlords and vendors; licensed electrical or certified rigging work always goes through a qualified provider. * Supports compliance with local health and safety requirements (fire safety, first aid coordination, risk prevention) and helps organize mandatory training and drills. * Project Support, Budget & Continuous Improvement * Supports vendor coordination and project tracking for regional technical and workplace initiatives. * Assists with budget tracking for AV, workplace, and technical equipment expenses across EMEA. * Identifies opportunities to improve employee experience through better tools and light automation (e.g. Notion-based workflows); curiosity here is valued, deep automation or data ownership is not expected of this role. * Assists with small office moves, adds, and changes involving technical systems. * Collaboration & Reporting * Works in close collaboration with the PREWFI EMEA team to ensure alignment across Workplace, Facilities, and Technical activities. * Partners closely with Infrastructure and Security on systems, network, and infrastructure projects. * Coordinates with HR, Finance,IT, Infrastructure, Security, and external contractors for smooth office operations in Dublin and regional consistency across EMEA. * Regular travel to Paris, Dublin, and other EMEA offices for AV, infrastructure, and technical work — core to the role, not occasional. **We Could Be a Match If** * About 5 years of relevant experience (event production, AV, technical support, or similar hands-on technical field work). Not an entry-level role: it requires working independently without close oversight, traveling autonomously, and making sound judgment calls on time and priorities. * A "figure-it-out" mindset: you feel energized by diving into new building automation, IoT, or infrastructure platforms and are eager to take direct ownership of their evolution. * A collaborative approach to IT and network fundamentals, enabling you to partner effectively with specialized teams to solve integrated technical challenges. * Curiosity about data and automation; you see the potential in using tools like Claude, Google Apps Script or Notion to help the team work smarter and more efficiently. * Hands-on and field-oriented: comfortable physically troubleshooting AV, network closets, and building-technology touchpoints without needing to escalate every issue. * Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with an ability to keep multiple technical threads moving forward. * Fluency in English is required; French or German language skills would be a wonderful asset given our regular travel and collaboration across Paris and the wider region. * Genuinely curious about technology and quick to pick up new tools and systems, without needing much hand-holding. * Stays calm and follows procedures under pressure — live event, packed room, something's not working — without getting flustered or freezing up. **Why Match Group?** * Work on products that impact millions, collaborating with global and diverse teams, shaping relationships and connections worldwide. * Access premium healthcare, mental health support, and emergency leaves. * Benefit from a healthy work-life balance in a flexible and welcoming environment. * Enjoy a modern office, close to transport and amenities. * Access lunch vouchers and a discounted ClassPass subscription. * Grow through e-learning, conferences, knowledge-sharing sessions, continuous learning programs, and global career opportunities * Join regular social events like breakfasts, lunches, and apéros. * Use our products for free. ***Match Group is an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our group.*** ***If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please let your Talent Acquisition partner know.***
